transactions.subject: Accepting the $49 Coursera micro-grant — thank you
transactions.message: Lisa — it's Zoe. I'm coming in this week to formally accept the mutual aid grant for the Coursera subscription. I wanted to say thank you directly. I've been in the certificate program since tick 4 — it's 22% done and I didn't want to cancel it but I was getting close to having to make that call. The $49 matters. I will be there Thursday for Kevin O'Brien's office hours too. I'm not going in expecting anything — I just want to understand what my options actually look like from someone who will give me a straight answer. See you soon.
transactions.detail: Zoe formally accepts the $49/month Coursera micro-grant from the community center mutual aid fund that Lisa Freeman offered in tick 7. Reduces Zoe's out-of-pocket monthly expenses by $49. Coursera enrollment continues without lapse.

relationship_effect.notes: Zoe follows through on the warm handoff Lisa created. Accepting the offer and confirming Thursday attendance closes the loop on the outreach and deepens the relationship with the community center as a resource. Lisa's investment in Zoe is validated.

transactions.subject: Thursday office hours — Zoe Martinez, retraining enrollee
transactions.message: Hi Kevin — my name is Zoe Martinez. Lisa Freeman told me about your Thursday evening office hours at the community center and I'm going to be there. I'm 22, currently unemployed, enrolled in a Coursera digital marketing certificate, and running gig delivery work to cover expenses while I finish the program. Credit score around 581. Zero savings right now. I'm not coming in expecting a loan approval — I understand what my numbers look like. I'm coming in because I want to understand what my actual options are, what credit-building looks like from where I am, and whether the bank has any products relevant to someone in a retraining situation. Lisa said no application pressure and I'm taking her at her word. I just want to know the real map.
transactions.detail: Zoe attends Kevin O'Brien's community center office hours. Seeking information about emergency bridge loan options (credit score 581, zero income), credit-building products, and any bank programs for retraining enrollees. No commitment to apply — information-gathering only.

relationship_effect.notes: First direct interaction between Zoe and Kevin O'Brien. Facilitated by Lisa Freeman's warm introduction. Zoe's transparency about her situation and realistic expectations lowers the transactional pressure. Kevin gains a clearer picture of who is coming through the community center pipeline.
